name: Cistera Networks, Inc.
summary: Cistera Networks, Inc. operates as a provider of cloud-based business communication solutions in the United States. It offers call recording software, emergency alert solutions, call recording analytics, and recording and biometric access control solutions for call center software, education, transport, first responders, hospital, energy, aviation, and stadiums and events sectors. The company was formerly known as CNH Holdings Company and changed its name to Cistera Networks, Inc. in September 2005. Cistera Networks, Inc. was founded in 1987 and is based in Plano, Texas.
